title: Index ideas batch 3: option-expiration week and cross-index weekly reversal
registered: 2026-10-15, before any Gen76 number was computed (after Gen75 results were seen; these two ideas were not part of Gen75)
costs_splits_pass: as Gen75 (1 bp per side indices, 3%/yr financing per night; DEV 2013-19 / TEST 2020-23 / HOLD 2024-26; TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, DEV > 0, then the CFD-portfolio check)

O1 option-expiration week (Stivers & Sun.rule: US500 and US100: long from the daily close (16:00 NY) of the Friday before the monthly option expiration (3rd Friday) to the close of the expiration Friday; flat otherwise; equal weight
O1 option-expiration week (Stivers & Sun.variant: short the week after expiration (close of expiration Friday to close of the following Friday)

O2 cross-index weekly reversal (short-ho.rule: US500, US100, US30, DE40: at each Friday close (US 16:00 NY; DE40 17:00 Berlin bar close on the same Friday), rank by the past-week return; long the worst, short the best, hold one week; unit notional per leg
